audit_kind: Independent transplant build and dependency check of copied final LaTeX only; not mathematical, novelty, citation-content or new page-by-page visual review
nonblocking_observations: All builds emit the epstopdf warning that shell escape is not enabled; this is the deliberately enforced policy, and no canonical manuscript uses includegraphics, external input/include files, minted, gnuplot or shell commands.
BM1-MAN-P06 has one existing underfull bibliography hbox (badness 7433, generated bbl lines 21-23), consistent with its historical PDF audit. No overfull box or compilation failure.
DM01-P13 and DM01-P15 have byte-identical duplicate main.tex entrypoints; only paper/main.tex was compiled, preserving the original relative bibliography layout.

Newly generated PDFs remain under work/latex-qa and must not replace archived final PDFs. Page-count agreement and successful clean compilation do not constitute fresh visual or mathematical acceptance.
